design.description: One opaque byte/word row-pair driver feeds the existing exact luma/chroma kernels. Normalize only two sixteen-pixel word tiles into128 stack bytes and consume them before overwrite. Gamma/permutation state is prepared once per operation. Tail and transparent/scalar preparation remain exact. No full-frame intermediate, new heap buffer, owner, cache or pool.
design.normalization: For all ushort s: n=min(s+128,65535), (n-(n>>8))>>8 equals (s+128)/257. Saturated rounded values all map to255. Original rounding, gamma, reciprocal, alpha opacity threshold, edge replication and complete packets are preserved.
